title: Grateful Dead Live at Merramec Community College on 1970-05-14
lineage: DAT > CDR > EAC > FLAC (with portions from MSR > MP3 > WAV > FLAC)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy soundboard capture featuring an outstanding Lovelight with the rare “Rock the Pig” outburst.
ai_review.review: The recording is a raw, rowdy soundboard source that preserves the full crowd roar and even captures Pig’s infamous “ROCK THE PIG!!” shout after Lovelight. Reviewers hail this version of Lovelight as one of the best ever heard, making the set2 partial a must‑listen for fans who love fast, furious Dead energy.

ai_rating.rationale: Single five‑star review emphasizes an exceptional performance and no major recording complaints, yielding a high rating but limited data for confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Raw and lively soundboard feed; includes crowd cheering and the Pig shout that many other copies edit out. No specific complaints about muddiness or drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial second set delivered at a breakneck, furious pace; the energy stays high throughout and culminates with an unedited crowd reaction after Lovelight.
